title: Convolutional Recurrent Neural Networks for Dynamic MR Image Reconstruction
layout_note: Three grey-outlined panels: (a) on the left, tall, holds the compact network as a bottom-to-top stack of layer boxes with a residual add, a DC box fed by the k-space samples, and a feedback line from output to input; two large hollow block arrows labelled 'Unfolding (iteration)' and 'Unfolding (time)' point right to (b) top right — the same network unrolled into a grid of hidden-state circles (rows = layers, columns = iterations) capped by DC boxes — and (c) bottom right, the recurrent layer unrolled over time frames.
grouping: Panels are thin grey square-cornered frames with (a)/(b)/(c) labels inside the top left corner; the recurrent-layer stack in (a) sits in a dashed blue rectangle titled CRNN. Layer type is colour-coded and repeated across panels: peach for the bidirectional time-and-iteration layer, light blue for the iteration-recurrent layers, white/grey for the plain CNN and DC; in (b) each layer row is a grey rectangle holding one circle per iteration.
shapes_depth: Flat lightly shaded boxes with grey outlines; hidden states are circles labelled H_l^(n). Input and k-space samples are small tilted 3-D slab thumbnails (an image sequence and a k-space volume seen in perspective). Arrow colour carries the connection type: green feed-forward, blue recurrence over iterations, orange recurrence over time, each mapped to a weight symbol (W_l, W_i, W_t) in a legend inside the panel and in a shared legend below (a).
proposed_highlight: The proposed recurrent layers carry the only fills (peach, light blue) and are expanded twice by the labelled unfolding arrows, so the recurrence over iterations and over time each get their own panel.
lesson: Two big hollow arrows labelled by the axis they unroll (iteration, time) lead from the compact network to two unrolled panels, and arrow colour (green, blue, orange) stays bound to one weight type in every panel.
notes: venue IEEE TMI from the arXiv comment ('Published in IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging'); year = arXiv preprint year (1712.01751). Box labels sans-serif, block-arrow labels serif, math in serif bold (x_rec, H).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.note: paradigm: cascaded CNN with data consistency (Schlemper DC-CNN); MoDL is the closest listed unrolled paradigm.

core.what: the CRNN-MRI block in (a) is unrolled twice: a blue 'Unfolding (iteration)' block arrow leads to (b), a grid of hidden-state circles with layers as rows and iterations as columns, and a red 'Unfolding (time)' block arrow leads to (c), one recurrent layer unrolled over time frames

relations.form: (b) three columns of H_l^(i) circles (iterations 1, 2, N) with blue arrows along each layer row from one iteration to the next and DC boxes on top of each column
two hollow block arrows from panel (a) to panels (b) and (c), each panel framed in grey
(a) bottom to top: undersampled image x_rec^(i-1) -> dashed CRNN stack (BCRNN-t-i, three CRNN-i, CNN) -> ⊕ with a residual line -> DC with k-space samples entering from the left -> x_rec^(i)
the k-space samples thumbnail feeds the DC block by an arrow labelled Ω; residual lines from the input loop round the stack into the ⊕
(c) draws forward and backward hidden states for frames t-1, t, t+1 receiving curved arrows from the previous iteration's states and the layer below

channels.colour: arrow colour = weight type, keyed and used in every panel (green feed-forward W_l, blue recurrent over iterations W_i, orange recurrent over time W_t); block-arrow colour and fills match it: blue = iteration (Unfolding (iteration) arrow, CRNN-i blocks and states), orange/red = time (Unfolding (time) arrow, the BCRNN-t-i block and its states)
channels.shape: rectangles = layers and DC, circles = hidden states, ⊕ = residual add, MRI and k-space thumbnails = data
channels.line: solid coloured arrows = connections by weight type; dark grey lines = residual and data-consistency wiring
channels.frame: grey frames = the three panels; a dashed blue box = the CRNN sub-network

quality.strengths: Colour is bound to one meaning across all three panels (weight type, which also marks iteration vs time recurrence), keyed in a legend; the two kinds of recurrence get their own unrolled panels tied to the block by matching-colour block arrows; data appear as real k-space and image thumbnails.
quality.weaknesses: Panel (c) is a tangle of crossing curved green, blue and orange arrows that is hard to trace; in (b) the dark lines from each column's output wander over to the next column's ⊕ with several bends; the legend in (a)'s corner and the separate W legends in (b) and (c) repeat the same key three times.

insights.structure: Three grey-outlined panels: tall (a) CRNN-MRI on the left with a dashed CRNN sub-box of stacked layers; (b) top right unrolls over iterations as a grid of hidden-state circles (rows = layers, columns = iterations); (c) bottom right unrolls the recurrent layer over time.
insights.data: k-space samples and the image are small real 3D-tilted MRI thumbnails; hidden states are labelled circles H_l^(i); math labels x_rec^(i), x_u in serif bold.
insights.emphasis: Two big hollow block arrows labelled 'Unfolding (iteration)' (blue) and 'Unfolding (time)' (red) link (a) to (b) and (c); arrow colour (green W_l, blue W_i, orange W_t) is bound to one weight type in every panel.
insights.flow: Bottom to top within each panel with feedback lines on the left; left to right from compact to unrolled views.
insights.avoid: Panel (c) has many crossing coloured curves between circles that are hard to trace; legends are repeated in three places.

arrangement.units: three grey-outlined panels labelled (a)-(c): (a) tall on the left, (b) and (c) stacked on the right, linked by hollow block arrows
arrangement.inputs_as: tilted real MRI thumbnail (undersampled image) and k-space sample thumbnail
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; DC boxes sit at the top of (a) and (b)
arrangement.shared: the same layer stack (BCRNN-t-i, CRNN-i x3, CNN) appears compact in (a) and unrolled in (b)
